claim.quote: After operation of GENIUS-TF over three years with finally six naked Ge detectors (15kg) in liquid nitrogen in Gran Sasso, we realize serious problems for realization of a full-size GENIUS-like experiment

name: Status of GENIUS-TF-II and TF-III: the long-term stability of naked detectors in liquid nitrogen

published.quote: Journal Name: Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research. Section A, Accelerators, Spectrometers, Detectors and Associated Equipment; Journal Volume: 566; Journal Issue: 2

summary.plain: After three years the six bare germanium detectors in liquid nitrogen could not be kept stable, which cast doubt on a full-size version of the idea.
summary.technical: Background from 222Rn diffusing into the setup far above expectation, and limited long-term stability of naked detectors in liquid nitrogen from increasing leakage current: none of the six detectors ran after three years with the nominal leakage current, and three no longer worked at all.

title: Status of GENIUS-TF-II and TF-III: the long-term stability of naked detectors in liquid nitrogen
why_it_matters: The end-of-run verdict on the naked-germanium-in-liquid-nitrogen technique at LNGS.
